question: Where are a nature reserve located within a 160 kilometers range toward the southwest of Barons Bus Arena, Parma, OH?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Barons Bus Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Parma%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ) AS arena WHERE p.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, arena.geometry::geography, 160000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(arena.geometry, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
